items.summary: AI sustainability reporting for a London climate-tech firm: climate risk, GHG calculations, disclosure gap analysis and transition planning, plus the internal tools across Terra Real Estate, Asset Intelligence and Survey Automation.

highlights.text: Built LLM-driven, structured ESG workflows, including disclosure gap analysis against ISSB, TCFD and CSRD (ESRS), and estimation pipelines.
Built AI document and data pipelines that extract sustainability and corporate-entity data at scale, feeding GHG boundary-setting and ownership extraction.
Engineered the platform core: workflow orchestration, background processing, RBAC and transactional audit logging.

Set org standards for Express, NestJS and React (routes → controller → service → repository, Zod, CASL, Drizzle, React Query) behind a multi-workspace React + Vite frontend for the CRM, client portal, PM and market intelligence.
Runs a multi-agent Claude Code pipeline for autonomous coding.

items.summary: Kickstart HQ, a field-service management product covering scheduling, dispatching, invoicing, technicians and payments.

highlights.text: Cut response time from 27s to 3.5s with webpack optimisation, code splitting and compression.
Added lazy loading and removed redundant API calls across the scheduling and dispatch flows.

items.summary: Wearable-sensor human activity recognition, published in Springer's Multimedia Tools and Applications (2026).

highlights.text: Built MotionIQ: an Android app that streams phone IMU data over Wi-Fi into RabbitMQ, drained by a Java consumer.
Wrote the Python preprocessing pipeline: name standardisation, atomic 5-second windows and fall segmentation into Fall and ADL datasets.
Second of five authors on HumCareADL and HyMCL-Net, a hybrid CNN-LSTM for activity recognition.
